name: Sage
tagline: Teachers build courses through staged AI drafting and review; students learn in the same system with 3D simulations.
problem: Teachers and students now use separate systems, so teachers cannot see how students learn with AI.
solution: A staged creation pipeline (outline, drafting, enrichment, quality review) keeps teachers in control before publishing learning paths that students use with interactive simulations.
demo_moment: Team-described: draft a course, review a weak section, publish and open a simulation as a student.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Keeps a review stage before anything reaches students.

lessons: Put the human review step in the product, not in the pitch.
